name: smwmusic-touhou-sangetsusei-great-fairy-wars-magus-night-star-mix
title: Touhou Sangetsusei ~ Great Fairy Wars - Magus Night (Star-mix)
description:
Did a short arrangement of Magus Night from Touhou 12.8 Sangetsusei ~ Great Fairy Wars. I already did one's for Reimu, Sanae, Sonic, and Mega Man, so I gotta do Marisa now. I thought I'd give Magus Night the spotlight for this one. Not exactly my favorite theme of hers, but it's still p-neat.

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. E (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. C# Minor (Alternate Pitch)
ㅤ3. F# Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
ㅤ4. D# Minor (Custom Pitch 2)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Enables the Intro (INTRO Enabled)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. Skips the Intro (INTRO Disabled)
